text: Findings: live fills are rare mostly because there is little to buy. Right now 2 live games; the closest lines were 11% and 20% sure against the 90% the live lane requires (it only buys near-decided outcomes, edge floor 2.5-5%). Over the last scans: 2,779 judgments, 0 offers; earlier 31,854 judgments, 4 offers. The edge floor is not the blocker; the 90% confidence is. I have no settled live results yet to prove that dropping it to 80% is +EV (the model-only fair is unvalidated, and a wrong model at 80% loses fast), so I am not loosening real-money live rules blind. Plan: record paper offers at 75-89% confidence on the engine so a day of busy slates shows their real hit rate, then lower the threshold to whatever the results support. Logged as CH2.
